research_basis: Han, Kang & Ryu (SSRN, revised 2026): strong evidence for time-series momentum in crypto under realistic assumptions; cross-sectional momentum evidence is weak.
Yang (Finance Research Letters, 2025): risk-managed momentum improves average weekly return and Sharpe; robustness includes transaction costs and short-sale constraints.

Bui & Nguyen (arXiv, 2026): H6 trend-following with ATR trailing stop and adaptive asset selection outperformed H1/H4/H8/H12/D1 benchmarks OOS; dynamic trailing stop was the largest ablation contributor.
execution_scope: Binance Spot long-only; no leverage; no futures; no shorts
universe_rule: Top 15 current Binance Spot USDT pairs by rolling 30d quote-volume, excluding stablecoins, leveraged tokens, wrapped/gold proxies; require >=365d history and >=10M USDT rolling 30d average daily quote volume

signal.rule: long only when 30d return > 0 and close > EMA200
signal.market_regime: BTCUSDT close > EMA200 and BTC 30d return > 0
signal.trailing_stop: highest close since entry - 2.5 * ATR14; stop never loosens

selection.rank: highest 30d return divided by 30d realized volatility among eligible assets

risk.position_size_rule: min(7 USDT, 0.20 USDT / stop_distance_fraction); never violate reserve

rule: No threshold changes after seeing results; if it fails, reject it rather than tune it post hoc.
